authorization.request: 2026-11-23: 提交失败：Repository rule violations found Code scanning is waiting for results from CodeQL for the commit 7f60c60. 同步榜单失败
authorization.scope: Make the plugin radar publish path compatible with the existing main branch ruleset by using a scoped pull request and the repository's auto-merge workflow. No change to the ruleset, Catalog, Profile, servers or credentials.

objective: Publish `registry/storefront-curation.json` through a branch PR that CodeQL and a scoped validator gate, without weakening the main branch code-scanning rule.

rootCause.observed: createCommitOnBranch targeted main directly and the ruleset rejected the ref update: Code scanning is waiting for results from CodeQL for commit 7f60c6032bf1766e6d280cd9676b818f971cd605.
rootCause.evidence: The verified commit 7f60c60 exists as a dangling object (parent 63dc4da3) but no branch points at it; no file on main changed.
rootCause.rule: ruleset 20904616 requires code scanning and code quality results for the default branch; PR heads receive CodeQL analysis, direct pushes do not.

fix.plugin: dsh-plugin-scout 0.2.1 creates `plugin-scout/storefront-<timestamp>`, writes the verified commit on that branch with expectedHeadOid=main, opens a PR, and best-effort enables squash auto-merge. Failed commits or PR creation delete the temporary branch.
fix.store: New `storefront-pr-automerge.yml` runs only for `plugin-scout/storefront-` PRs, requires OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR authorship and exactly one changed file, validates the file with `scripts/validate-storefront-curation.mjs`, then enables squash auto-merge.
fix.gates: CodeQL and code quality remain required by the existing ruleset; the curation PR is additionally validated by the new workflow and by `npm run check` on registry changes.

excludedMutations: installed Profiles, packages or DSH runtime
production servers, systemd units, model settings or credentials
verification: after merge: plugin publish creates a PR; auto-merge waits for CodeQL; Pages readback of curation.json
